stories.limits: The state changes because evidence and a new claim version became available; nothing here shows a causal improvement in a real business.

steps.label: Known then: the ride is complete but the claim is blocked
steps.text: The leg has its ride, census row and references, but the billing party reference is unknown. SYN-C01:CL001:v1 is blocked for initial preparation and encounter submission; both units stay in the M14 and M15 denominators.

steps.label: Restated then: the new version is known later, not backdated
steps.text: The reference arrives after T. SYN-C01:CL001:v2 (available 2026-07-16T12:00:00Z) is listed as known later; the active version at T stays SYN-C01:CL001:v1, so readiness at T is unchanged.

steps.label: Current later: version 2 is ready from its own availability
steps.text: Readiness begins at 2026-07-16T12:00:00Z, when version 2 and every supporting fact exist. The exact version 2 payload is submitted.

steps.label: Downstream: a supported rejection, which is outcome evidence
steps.text: The receiver's encounter decision rejects both components with originating evidence. That is a source-evidenced outcome in M16, not acceptance, and the leg stays uncovered in M01.

steps.label: Comparison: a directly evidenced acceptance
steps.text: A comparable leg whose every component has originating acceptance, so it counts in the M01 numerator.

stories.teaser: One completed leg, blocked by a missing billing reference, becomes ready only when that evidence arrives, then receives a supported rejection.
stories.title: A ride becomes a supported claim, then meets a limited outcome

stories.limits: Visibility differences are not business acceptance-rate differences. The six routes are disclosed synthetic policies.

steps.label: Originating structured response
steps.text: The recipient's own exact-scope decision: source-evidenced acceptance.

steps.label: Forwarded originating response
steps.text: An intermediary delivered the recipient's original artifact; the issuer's authority is kept, so it is still source evidence.

steps.label: A promised route that failed
steps.text: The encounter decision was due 2026-04-06T00:00:00Z and has not arrived: an overdue receipt that stays a miss, while the business outcome stays unknown.

steps.label: Record-specific client assertion
steps.text: The client says this record was accepted; that stays a labeled assertion and never becomes source-evidenced acceptance.

steps.label: Aggregate note
steps.text: A note that several items were processed supplies no record membership, stage or timing; the unit remains without a record outcome.

steps.label: Structurally unavailable final return
steps.text: No final-response route exists, so no receipt promise is invented; the reporting requirement and its follow-up remain.

stories.teaser: Six clients, one requirement each: evidence authority and return routes differ, and that is not a difference in business acceptance.
stories.title: The same reporting need, different evidence

stories.limits: The duplicate-coverage case does not occur in the operational population; it is shown from the public golden miniature.

steps.label: One grouped claim, four units
steps.text: SYN-C03:CL001:v2 groups two services for one member and date. Each component keeps its own line and allocation; the grouped transmission waits until every component is ready.

steps.label: Partial downstream evidence
steps.text: Some required components have source-evidenced acceptance and others do not, so the leg is partially covered and stays out of M01.

steps.label: Two legitimate destinations, not a duplicate
steps.text: SYN-C02 reports each leg to its encounter recipient and, separately, to an audit recipient. The four units (two components, two targets) belong to two different families, so neither is a duplicate of the other: here the audit target is accepted while the encounter target is rejected, and each outcome stays with its own target.

steps.label: A required cancelled-trip report outside C
steps.text: Under profile P-C a documented cancellation is a required reporting unit with a supported zero charge. It is in U, never in the completed-leg population, and never over-reporting.

steps.label: A cancellation the profile excludes
steps.text: Under profile P-A a cancelled trip creates no reporting requirement: SYN-C01:Q002001 is explicitly excluded from P, so it has no preparation unit, no claim and no report, and its absence is not a gap.

golden.rationale: Grouping does not collapse P; distinct destinations are legitimate.

stories.teaser: Two services on one claim header still make four preparation and reporting units; a cancelled trip can still need a report.
stories.title: Grouped claims and broader reporting

steps.text: Supplier cost 25.23 and submitted charge 38.22 are separate facts. Member responsibility 5.00 is known; member collection is unknown, so no cash receipt is implied.

steps.label: A settlement and its allocation
steps.text: Settlement 20.00: 18.00 applied to the vendor payment and 2.00 unapplied, reconciling to zero residual.

steps.label: A later-known reversal keeps both events
steps.text: A reversal of -20.00, effective before T but received after the original K, appears only at restated then. The original settlement is retained; gross and net flows are both kept.
